title: Palisades (Holtec restart): External_Sender Holtec's Fuel Handling Accident and Rushed Comment Period [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:         daryl237@yahoo.com
To:           Marlayna Doell
Subject:      [External_Sender] Holtec"s fuel handling accident and rushed comment period
Date:         Thursday, October 8, 2026 3:58:24 PM


Dear Marlayna Doell,
The tilting of previously irradiated fuel assembly DD41 should not result in a rush to
declare a finding of no significant hazards as a basis for a solution to an
unprecedented endeavor.
The stunning lack of information that has been provided to the public after more than
a month and this rushed comment period for our consent, reeks of a complicit
relationship with Holtec.
That Holtec has allowed this to happen is another example of their lax oversight of an
operation that it has no experience in practice.
That the NRC has continuously enabled Holtec to advance to this "oops" situation is
unacceptable. Now the public is expected to suspend its disbelief of Holtec's
competence with no more, or very little more, information than its original press
release and with about 44 hours' notice.
I do not consent to this proposal. Please allow more time to consider it and with more
information about the condition of fuel assembly and the predicament that Holtec has
fallen into.

Sincerely,
Daryl Davis
Ohio Green Party
216-848-6912
